Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial: model selection & success criteria

Hi Anna / Javier —

Thanks for a great call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC going: 

Summary of what we heard
- Goal: prototype AI assistant for customer support answers and knowledge retrieval across product catalogs (English + Spanish).
- Volume: ~5k queries/day in pilot; latency target 300–500ms 95th pct.
- Success criteria (we'll refine): accuracy ≥ 85% on a 200-sample test set; multilingual (EN/ES) parity within 5% of each other; latency SLA 95th ≤ 500ms; cost < $0.01/query during trial.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): align on success criteria and test set owner (you).
- Week 1: Redwood provides baseline models and config; we spin up trial env and sample prompts.
- Week 2: ACME runs evaluation, shares feedback & failure cases.
- Week 3: iterate on prompts/model selection and finalize recommendation.

POC model recommendation (initial)
- Primary: Llama 2 13B (quantized) — balance of quality and latency for retrieval-augmented tasks.
- Fallback: Llama 2 7B (quantized) — faster, cheaper option if latency or cost constraints bite.
- Notes: If Spanish performance lags, we can test a specialized multilingual variant or apply targeted fine-tuning & prompt templates.

Ownership & next steps
- Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) — she will provision the trial and own runbooks.
- ACME owner: Anna Kim — please confirm the test-set owner and provide a sample dataset (200 items) by Friday.
- Action: I'll attach our POC template and the security questionnaire you asked about.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_poc_template.pdf (12 KB)], [Attachment: acme_security_questions.xlsx (45 KB)]

If that looks good, Marissa will reach out to schedule the provisioning kickoff.

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: POC trial: model selection & success criteria

Thanks Ben — really helpful recap. Javier and I aligned internally and we have a few clarifications and asks: 

1) Test-set owner: Javier will own assembling the 200-sample test set (mix of English/Spanish). We'll aim to deliver by EOD Friday (Aug 21).
2) Security: our InfoSec team will need the completed questionnaire and any SOC2 evidence early in the process. I'll loop in our security contact if needed.
3) Multilingual requirement: Spanish queries represent ~30% of expected volume. We'll need to see baseline Spanish performance before committing to the 13B as default.

Success criteria: those look good to us; we might propose also tracking "rate of hallucination on product attributes" as a metric.

Can Marissa confirm what telemetry/logging we get in the trial (per-request latencies, token counts, top-k responses)? Also: are you able to support an A/B across two model variants for comparison?

If you can confirm Marissa is our technical lead, we'll go ahead and deliver the sample set Friday and schedule a 30-minute kickoff for next Monday.

Best,
Anna

Hi Anna / Javier —

Thanks — happy to be the technical lead. Quick answers to your questions and a few asks to make the trial smooth: 

Telemetry & A/B
- Telemetry available in trial: per-request latency, token counts, request/response payloads, top-k candidates (when using n-best), and a simple hallucination flag we can populate from human review.
- We can run an A/B across two endpoints (Llama 2 13B vs Llama 2 7B) and provide side-by-side logs + a small eval script to compute accuracy/hallucination metrics.

Model selection notes
- Baseline: Llama 2 13B (quantized — q4) for quality; fallback Llama 2 7B (q4) for cost/latency.
- Multilingual: We'll run a quick Spanish micro-benchmark during Week 1 (50 Spanish prompts) to measure delta. If Spanish is >6% worse, we recommend testing a multilingual-specialized checkpoint (we have a few candidates) or lightweight fine-tuning (~2000 examples).

Provisioning & access
- I'll provision a dedicated trial endpoint and a shared logging S3 bucket. Please confirm which ACME emails need access for logs.
- Can ACME sign a short trial addendum (covers data handling/TOS)? Ben — can you share the DocuSign link after this thread?

Proposed kickoff: Mon, Aug 24 — 10:00am PT (30 min) — agenda: provisioning review, test-set handoff, run-of-show for Week 1. I'll send a calendar invite when Anna confirms.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0188
